Question: Please give me a list of sahabiyat names as to name my daughter ( Khadija, Kulsoom, Ruqayya, Hafsa, Ayisha,Ruqayya, Haleema, Sadia, Safiyya, Zainab, Habeeba - these names are already there in our family). Answer ID: 22957 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1210/919/H=1431) (a) Maimoona, (b) Safiya, (c) Juwairia, (d) Sauda, (e) Atikah, (f) Kabsha, (g) Fatimah, (h) Umm Salma, (i) Umm Sulaim, (j) Umm Subaih, (k) Umm Habibah, (l) Umm Kulsum, (m) Umm Ruman (رضي الله تعالى عنهن) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
